title: Divide Array Into Equal Pairs
summary: Given an integer array nums consisting of 2n integers, determine if it is possible to divide the array into n pairs such that each pair contains identical elements.
statement: Given an integer array nums consisting of 2n integers, determine if it is possible to divide the array into n pairs such that each pair contains identical elements. Return true if such a division is possible, otherwise return false.
constraints: Every pair must contain two equal values and every element must be used once.
Return true exactly when such a partition exists.
hints: Equal pairing is possible independently for each distinct value.
Count nums and return all(count % 2 == 0 for count in frequencies).
Even counts can be partitioned into pairs, while any odd count necessarily leaves one unmatched occurrence.
editorial: Even counts can be partitioned into pairs, while any odd count necessarily leaves one unmatched occurrence.

tests.explanation: Counts are two threes and four twos, both even, so equal pairs can be formed.
Every value occurs once, so no equal pairing can use all elements.
